INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, period, theme, pay, lr, "offset", anchor_date)
VALUES ($1, 'main', NULL, 'all', 'all', 0, 0, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step        = EXCLUDED.step,
    period      = EXCLUDED.period,
    theme       = EXCLUDED.theme,
    pay         = EXCLUDED.pay,
    lr          = EXCLUDED.lr,
    "offset"    = EXCLUDED."offset",
    anchor_date = EXCLUDED.anchor_date
RETURNING *;

/* SQL #5 — Read-only state for invalid fallback (always returns 1 row) */

WITH s AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.user_state WHERE chat_id = $1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT chat_id FROM s), $1)        AS chat_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT step FROM s), 'main')       AS step,
  (SELECT period FROM s)                       AS period,
  COALESCE((SELECT theme FROM s), 'all')       AS theme,
  COALESCE((SELECT pay FROM s), 'all')         AS pay,
  COALESCE((SELECT lr FROM s), 0)              AS lr,
  COALESCE((SELECT "offset" FROM s), 0)        AS "offset",
  (SELECT anchor_date FROM s)                  AS anchor_date,
  COALESCE((SELECT updated_at FROM s), now())  AS updated_at,
  (SELECT user_state_id FROM s)                AS user_state_id;

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, "offset")
VALUES ($1, 'main', 0)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step     = EXCLUDED.step,
    "offset" = EXCLUDED."offset"
RETURNING *;

/* SQL #3 — v2|set|theme=<code> (theme + step=main)
Don’t set anchor_date or "offset"; trigger does it.*/

INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, theme, step)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'main')
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET theme = EXCLUDED.theme,
    step  = EXCLUDED.step
RETURNING *;

/* v2|set|lr=<0|1>  (lr + step=main)
Do NOT set anchor_date or "offset"; trigger handles offset reset.
*/
INSERT INTO public.user_state (chat_id, step, lr)
VALUES ($1, 'main', $2::smallint)
ON CONFLICT (chat_id) DO UPDATE
SET step = EXCLUDED.step,
    lr   = EXCLUDED.lr
RETURNING *;
